responsibility: Validates MIR bodies after transformation stages by checking control-flow, phase-specific dialect invariants, and type correctness, reporting broken MIR when passes produce bodies that violate compiler expectations. Some storage-liveness and local-storage undefined-behavior checks historically lived here, including diagnostics for using a local without storage, but belong to MIR linting when the MIR is structurally valid and the problem is an erroneous or undefined local-storage state rather than a core validator invariant.
